items.title: Ukrainian Soldiers Brave Russian Drones On Trek To Frontline Settlements
items.description: Ukrainian troops trek nearly 20 kilometers to reach Bilozerske in the embattled Donetsk region. In roughly one year, Russian drone and aerial attacks have laid waste to the city that used to house 15,000 inhabitants. Speaking with RFE/RL, one soldier said that "everything is bad" in the Dobropillia area.
